description: This file defines the SettingsEditor class for generating and rewriting settings.php files in Drupal, including methods for updating configuration values and handling PHP tokens.

classes.name: SettingsEditor
classes.description: Final class providing static methods to rewrite settings.php files, manage configuration settings, and handle PHP token parsing.

methods.name: rewrite
methods.description: Replaces values in a specified settings.php file with provided configuration data, handling PHP token parsing and cache invalidation.

methods.name: isSimple
methods.description: Checks if a token type and value represent a scalar or null value.

methods.name: isArrayIndex
methods.description: Checks if a token type is a valid array index (number or string).

methods.name: setGlobal
methods.description: Recursively sets a nested value in the global scope.

methods.name: exportSettingsToPhp
methods.description: Recursively exports settings data to PHP code string.

methods.name: exportSingleSettingToPhp
methods.description: Exports a single setting value and comment to PHP code string.
